title: Tomato Indigo Rose - 2x Mini Plug Plants
description:
Grow Your Own Superfood: Stunning Purple Tomatoes with High Antioxidants!

KEY FEATURES
• Unique deep purple to black skin, rich in anthocyanin antioxidants.
• Grafted for increased disease resistance and vigorous growth.
• Mildly sweet, earthy flavour perfect for fresh salads and garnishes.
• Cordon variety, producing continuous harvests of small to medium-sized fruits.
• Visually stunning, adding an exotic touch to your garden and plate.

PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Solanum lycopersicum 'Indigo Rose'
Colour: Dark purple/black skin, red flesh
Season: Summer (July to October)
Growth Habit: Cordon (indeterminate)
Flavour: Mild to moderately sweet with an earthy undertone
Time to Harvest: Approximately 70-80 days from planting

GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Moist but well-drained, fertile soil
Watering: Water deeply and regularly, keeping soil evenly moist. Avoid inconsistent watering to prevent fruit splitting.
Spacing: 45-60cm apart
Height: 1-1.5 metres
Spread: 0.5-1 metres
Hardiness: H1C (UK - will not tolerate frost)

CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a sunny, sheltered spot, either in a greenhouse, polytunnel, or outdoors after all risk of frost has passed.
• Support plants with tall canes or stakes as they grow, tying the main stem loosely.
• Regularly remove side shoots to maintain a single main stem and direct energy into fruit production.
• Once flowers appear and fruits begin to form, feed weekly with a high-potassium tomato fertiliser.
• Harvest when the shaded parts of the fruit turn red and the fruit feels slightly soft; the purple colour alone doesn't indicate ripeness.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
